notes:
Refers to the conscious effort to reduce consumption or spending in order to avoid waste. Can be applied to money, time, energy, water, and other resources. Implies prudent, deliberate reduction rather than deprivation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{食費|しょくひ}→食費：16477_shokuhi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{節約|せつやく}する: economize on food expenses
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{節約|せつやく}する: save time
- ⟦{水道代|すいどうだい}→水道代：09544_suidoudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{節約|せつやく}する: save on water bills
- ⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{節約|せつやく}する: conserve energy
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: frugal lifestyle
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧: money-saving tips

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{倹約|けんやく}→倹約：09203_kenyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be thrifty — emphasizes a lifestyle of careful, habitual frugality, while ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧ focuses more on specific acts of saving
- ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to save money — refers to putting money aside in savings, rather than reducing spending
- ⟦{浪費|ろうひ}する→浪費する：25239_rouhisuru⟧: to waste — the opposite of ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧, meaning to spend resources carelessly
